st: Can vs must, and the negativity of the Other

sec.p: Mental health and burnout concern our future. So 🎼 ff also returns to ❤️ Humans (as well as 🍃 Nature and 🖥️ Technology). Some time ago we saw 🎼 ff.62 How to avoid burnout, with Paul Millard, who left McKinsey to move to Taiwan. It's no coincidence that Byung-Chul Han, a…

Depression and burnout, then, are not external infections (the negativity of the Other), but internal explosions, of a potential-self that multiplies endlessly. Like a tumour. We're a long way, then, from Freud's Superego, which reins in the drives of the Id in a moralistic…

Han goes on, reflecting on the infinity of the Ego: If society and the social fabric are disappearing (the Other), the Ego is left with its own body, to be kept healthy at all costs. The capitalist economy absolutises survival. It rests on the illusion that more capital…

Mea culpa. I won't hide that Futuro Fortissimo is first and foremost positivism ( 🎼 ff.59 Optimism takes flight! ). And yet the negativity of the Other (the horn blaring in the queue at Paullo) seems to be the only cure for hyperactivity. Without this external limit, we sink…
